title: Orient project documentation around users
requires: Any development host with the current source and SDK build tools
scope: Audit the entire README against current driver capability code, build presets and published evidence; replace historical progress notes with application, Gallery and driver-author guidance. Document reproducible SDK and Gallery entry points, explicit backend selection and driver-author next steps; validate local links, presets, advertised command options and the installed C SDK example on the available host.
